len(handler_bytes):\n    if handler_bytes[i] == 0xE8:  # CALL relative\n        if i + 4 &lt; len(handler_bytes):\n            rel_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;i', handler_bytes[i+1:i+5])[0]\n            call_addr = func_ptr + i + 5 + rel_offset\n            print(f\"  CALL at handler+{i}: target 0x{call_addr:X}\")\n        i += 5\n    else:\n        i += 1\n\n# Also search for palette-related code patterns\n# Look for immediate references to 0x3C8 or 0x3C9 (VGA palette ports)\nprint(\"\\nSearching for VGA palette port access (0x3C8/0x3C9) near handler...\")\nsearch_start = code_offset - 0x500\nsearch_end = code_offset + 0x1000\nfor pos in range(search_start, search_end):\n    if exe_data[pos:pos+2] == b'\\xC8\\x03':  # 0x3C8 in little-endian\n        print(f\"  Found 0x03C8 at file offset 0x{pos:X} (code addr 0x{pos-0x4200:X})\")\n",

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nExtract the F8 action dispatch table from JUEGO.EXE\nTable at memory 0x47E58 (file offset 0x4BC58)\nFormat: 6 bytes per entry [uint16 id, uint32 func_ptr], terminated by 0xFFFF\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\n# F8 table at memory 0x47E58 -&gt; file offset 0x4BC58\n# (memory - 0x4200 = file offset for .text section)\ntable_file_offset = 0x47E58 - 0x4200 + 0x4200  # Actually it's in the data section\n# Memory address to file offset for this region differs\n# The data section typically starts at file offset 0x4B*00 ish\n\n# Let me calculate: Ghidra addr 0x47E58\n# Data section base: usually around 0x40000 in Ghidra but file starts at 0\n# For this EXE: addr 0x47E58 - assume memory base 0x10000 = 0x37E58 file offset? No...\n\n# Actually, looking at the documented tables:\n# \"Table 1 at file offset 0x4AFF0\" with data at memory 0x47D24\n# 0x47D24 - 0x4AFF0 + 0x4D24 = ?\n# Let me calculate: file_offset = mem_addr - 0x10000 + exe_header_offset\n# Or simpler: file_offset = mem_addr + delta where delta is constant for data section\n\n# From previous analysis: memory 0x48118 = file offset 0x4B318\n# Delta = 0x4B318 - 0x48118 = 0x3200\n# So file_offset = 0x47E58 + 0x3200 = 0x4B058\n\n# Wait let's verify with the known table addresses:\n# \"Table 1 at file offset 0x4AFF0\" - needs memory address\n# \"Table 2 at file offset 0x4B058\" corresponds to...\n\n# Actually the item table at 0x48118 has file offset 0x4B318\n# So delta = 0x3200\n# F8 table: memory 0x47E58 -&gt; file offset = 0x47E58 + 0x3200 = 0x4B058\n\n# But wait, 0x4B058 is documented as \"Table 2 at file offset 0x4B058\"\n# Which is NOT the F8 table. Let me re-check.\n\n# From handle_conversation_tree code: it uses DAT_00047e58\n# Let me search for a different offset calculation\n\n# The documented LOOK table is at 0x47BF0 (memory)\n# Let me check if the F8 table is documented elsewhere\n\n# Actually let me just search the EXE for the memory pattern\n# The table should have entries like [short id][ptr32]\n\n# Calculate using known mappings\n# If memory 0x47D24 -&gt; file 0x4AFF0 + some_offset\n# Wait no, the document says \"Table 1 at file offset 0x4AFF0\" \n# is the OPEN table, and in the code it shows 0x47D24\n\n# So: file_offset = memory_addr + (0x4AFF0 - 0x47D24) = memory_addr + 0x32CC\n# For 0x47E58: file_offset = 0x47E58 + 0x32CC = 0x4B124\n\n# Let's try multiple possible offsets\npossible_offsets = [\n    0x3200,   # based on item table\n    0x32CC,   # based on OPEN table\n    0x4B058 - 0x47E58,  # = 0x3200\n]\n\nprint(\"Looking for F8 action dispatch table (0x47E58)...\")\nprint()\n\nfor delta in set(possible_offsets):\n    file_offset = 0x47E58 + delta\n    print(f\"Trying file offset 0x{file_offset:X} (delta 0x{delta:X}):\")\n    \n    # Read table entries\n    pos = file_offset\n    entries = []\n    while pos &lt; len(exe_data) - 6:\n        entry_id, func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;HI', exe_data[pos:pos+6])\n        if entry_id == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"  Found terminator at offset 0x{pos:X}\")\n            break\n        entries.append((entry_id, func_ptr))\n        pos += 6\n        if len(entries) &gt; 200:  # Sanity limit\n            print(f\"  Too many entries, probably wrong offset\")\n            break\n    \n    if 1 &lt; len(entries) &lt; 200:\n        print(f\"  Found {len(entries)} entries\")\n        # Show first few entries\n        for i, (eid, fptr) in enumerate(entries[:10]):\n            print(f\"    [{i:3d}] ID {eid:5d} (0x{eid:04X}) -&gt; func 0x{fptr:05X}\")\n        if len(entries) &gt; 10:\n            print(f\"    ... ({len(entries) - 10} more)\")\n    print()\n\n# Also let me search for the actual 353 handler entry that was verified\n# Entry: 61 01 07 00 c1 2c 01 00 at file offset 0x4B348\nprint(\"Verification: Entry at 0x4B348:\")\nverify_data = exe_data[0x4B348:0x4B348+8]\nprint(f\"  Bytes: {verify_data.hex(' ')}\")\nv_item1, v_item2, v_func = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', verify_data)\nprint(f\"  item1={v_item1} (0x{v_item1:X}), item2={v_item2} (0x{v_item2:X}), func=0x{v_func:X}\")\n\n# Write full table to file\noutfile = open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/f8_table_extract.txt', 'w')\nfile_offset = 0x47E58 + 0x32CC  # Using the calculated offset\npos = file_offset\noutfile.write(f\"F8 Action Dispatch Table at file offset 0x{file_offset:X} (memory 0x47E58)\\n\")\noutfile.write(\"Format: [uint16 action_id][uint32 func_ptr]\\n\\n\")\noutfile.write(\"| Index | Action ID | Function Ptr |\\n\")\noutfile.write(\"|-------|-----------|-------------|\\n\")\n\ni = 0\nwhile pos &lt; len(exe_data) - 6:\n    entry_id, func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;HI', exe_data[pos:pos+6])\n    if entry_id == 0xFFFF:\n        outfile.write(f\"| --- | 0xFFFF (terminator) | --- |\\n\")\n        break\n    outfile.write(f\"| {i:3d} | {entry_id:5d} (0x{entry_id:04X}) | 0x{func_ptr:05X} |\\n\")\n    i += 1\n    pos += 6\n    if i &gt; 500:\n        outfile.write(\"... truncated ...\\n\")\n        break\n\noutfile.close()\nprint(f\"Full table written to f8_table_extract.txt\")\n",

}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze the amulet+statue handler at code address 0x12CC1.\nTrace what files/resources it accesses.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndef main():\n    with open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n        data = f.read()\n    \n    # Find the DOS EXE header info\n    # MZ header at start\n    if data[:2] != b'MZ':\n        print(\"Not a valid DOS EXE\")\n        return\n    \n    # Calculate code section offset\n    # For this particular exe, the item table at memory 0x48118 is at file 0x4B318\n    # Delta = 0x4B318 - 0x48118 = 0x3200\n    delta = 0x3200\n    \n    code_addr = 0x12CC1\n    file_offset = code_addr + delta\n    \n    print(f\"Analyzing handler at code address 0x{code_addr:X}\")\n    print(f\"File offset: 0x{file_offset:X}\")\n    print()\n    \n    # Read a chunk of code\n    chunk = data[file_offset:file_offset+300]\n    \n    print(\"Raw bytes:\")\n    for i in range(0, min(len(chunk), 128), 16):\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02X}' for b in chunk[i:i+16])\n        addr = code_addr + i\n        print(f\"  0x{addr:05X}: {hex_str}\")\n    print()\n    \n    # Find CALL instructions\n    print(\"CALL instructions (E8):\")\n    for i in range(len(chunk)-4):\n        if chunk[i] == 0xE8:\n            rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', chunk[i+1:i+5])[0]\n            target = code_addr + i + 5 + rel\n            if 0x10000 &lt;= target &lt;= 0x40000:  # Valid code range\n                print(f\"  +{i:3d} (0x{code_addr+i:05X}): CALL 0x{target:05X}\")\n    \n    # Look for file handle references\n    # Known file handles:\n    # - file_handle_alfred7 at 0x4F8FC\n    print()\n    print(\"Looking for known patterns...\")\n    \n    # Check if this handler triggers palette change\n    # The palette effect must happen somewhere - either in this handler\n    # or triggered by a flag it sets\n    \n    # Let's check what DAT addresses are referenced\n    print()\n    print(\"Potential memory references (MOV with 32-bit immediates):\")\n    for i in range(len(chunk)-5):\n        # A1 = MOV EAX, [imm32]\n        # 8B xx xx xx xx = MOV reg, [imm32] patterns\n        if chunk[i] == 0xA1:\n            addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', chunk[i+1:i+5])[0]\n            if 0x40000 &lt;= addr &lt;= 0x60000:\n                print(f\"  +{i:3d}: MOV EAX, [0x{addr:X}]\")\n        # Check for C7 05 (MOV dword ptr [imm32], imm32)\n        if chunk[i] == 0xC7 and chunk[i+1] == 0x05:\n            addr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', chunk[i+2:i+6])[0]\n            val = struct.unpack('&lt;I', chunk[i+6:i+10])[0]\n            if 0x40000 &lt;= addr &lt;= 0x60000:\n                print(f\"  +{i:3d}: MOV [0x{addr:X}], 0x{val:X}\")\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDump bytes at address 0x227be and 0x22842 where the statue_palette_fade_counter is accessed.\nThese addresses are not in recognized Ghidra functions.\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# Memory to file offset: +0x3200 (confirmed from prior analysis)\nMEM_TO_FILE = 0x3200\n\n# The counter at 0x495c4 is referenced at:\n# 0x1215e - WRITE (sets to 13)\n# 0x227be - READ  \n# 0x22842 - READ_WRITE (likely decrement and modify palette)\n\naddrs = [\n    (0x1215e, \"init_mouse_and_inventory (sets counter=13)\"),\n    (0x227be, \"READ counter\"),\n    (0x22842, \"READ_WRITE counter\"),\n]\n\nfor mem_addr, desc in addrs:\n    file_offset = mem_addr + MEM_TO_FILE\n    print(f\"=\" * 70)\n    print(f\"Address 0x{mem_addr:05X} ({desc})\")\n    print(f\"File offset: 0x{file_offset:08X}\")\n    print()\n    \n    # Dump 64 bytes starting 16 bytes before\n    start = file_offset - 16\n    print(\"Hex dump (16 bytes before, 48 bytes at/after):\")\n    for i in range(0, 64, 16):\n        addr = start + i\n        hex_str = data[addr:addr+16].hex(' ')\n        marker = \" &lt;-- HERE\" if i == 16 else \"\"\n        print(f\"  0x{addr:08X}: {hex_str}{marker}\")\n    print()\n\n# Let's also check what function contains 0x227be by looking at xrefs TO that code\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"Searching for what calls/jumps to code near 0x227be...\")\nprint()\n\n# Look for call/jmp patterns that target addresses near 0x227be\n# E8 xx xx xx xx = CALL rel32\n# E9 xx xx xx xx = JMP rel32\n\ntargets_to_find = [0x227be, 0x22842]\nfor target in targets_to_find:\n    print(f\"Looking for calls to 0x{target:08X}...\")\n    # Scan code segment for call instructions\n    code_start = 0x10000 + MEM_TO_FILE  # .object1 starts at 0x10000\n    code_end = 0x3e096 + MEM_TO_FILE\n    \n    found = []\n    for pos in range(code_start, code_end - 5):\n        if data[pos] == 0xE8:  # CALL rel32\n            rel32 = struct.unpack('&lt;i', data[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n            call_target = (pos - MEM_TO_FILE) + 5 + rel32  # mem addr of target\n            if call_target == target:\n                caller_mem = pos - MEM_TO_FILE\n                found.append(f\"CALL at mem 0x{caller_mem:08X}\")\n        elif data[pos] == 0xE9:  # JMP rel32\n            rel32 = struct.unpack('&lt;i', data[pos+1:pos+5])[0]\n            jmp_target = (pos - MEM_TO_FILE) + 5 + rel32\n            if jmp_target == target:\n                caller_mem = pos - MEM_TO_FILE\n                found.append(f\"JMP at mem 0x{caller_mem:08X}\")\n    \n    if found:\n        for f in found:\n            print(f\"  {f}\")\n    else:\n        print(\"  (none found)\")\n    print()\n\n# Check if the addresses might be inside an inline block or switch statement\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"Checking function boundaries near 0x227be...\")\nprint()\n\n# Look for function prologs (PUSH EBP; MOV EBP,ESP pattern)\n# 55 8B EC\npattern = bytes([0x55, 0x8B, 0xEC])\nsearch_start = 0x22000 + MEM_TO_FILE\nsearch_end = 0x23000 + MEM_TO_FILE\n\nprint(f\"Searching for function prologs in 0x22000-0x23000...\")\nfor pos in range(search_start, search_end):\n    if data[pos:pos+3] == pattern:\n        mem_addr = pos - MEM_TO_FILE\n        print(f\"  Function prolog at mem 0x{mem_addr:08X} (file 0x{pos:08X})\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDump per-frame dispatch tables using correct offset mapping\nMemory addr + 0x3200 = file offset (for data segment)\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\nimport sys\n\nexe_path = '/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE'\n\nwith open(exe_path, 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nprint(f\"JUEGO.EXE size: {len(data)} bytes (0x{len(data):X})\")\nprint()\n\n# Offset mapping: mem + 0x3200 = file\nDELTA = 0x3200\n\ndef dump_room_table(name, mem_addr):\n    file_offset = mem_addr + DELTA\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(f\"{name}\")\n    print(f\"Memory: 0x{mem_addr:08X}, File: 0x{file_offset:08X}\")\n    print()\n    \n    if file_offset &gt;= len(data):\n        print(\"ERROR: offset beyond file size!\")\n        return []\n    \n    entries = []\n    pos = file_offset\n    idx = 0\n    while pos &lt; len(data) - 6:\n        room = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[pos:pos+2])[0]\n        if room == 0xFFFF:\n            print(f\"  Entry {idx}: TERMINATOR (0xFFFF)\")\n            break\n        if room &gt; 60:\n            print(f\"  Entry {idx}: Invalid room {room}, stopping\")\n            break\n        handler = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[pos+2:pos+6])[0]\n        print(f\"  Entry {idx}: Room {room:2d} -&gt; handler 0x{handler:08X}\")\n        entries.append((room, handler))\n        pos += 6\n        idx += 1\n    \n    print()\n    return entries\n\n# Table at 0x48630 (render_scene per-frame)\nrender_entries = dump_room_table(\"RENDER_SCENE_PERFRAME (0x48630)\", 0x48630)\n\n# Table at 0x485bc (main_game_loop per-frame)  \nmain_entries = dump_room_table(\"MAIN_GAME_LOOP_PERFRAME (0x485bc)\", 0x485bc)\n\n# Summary\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nprint(\"ROOM 7 SEARCH\")\nprint(\"=\" * 70)\nfor name, entries in [(\"render_scene\", render_entries), (\"main_game_loop\", main_entries)]:\n    for room, handler in entries:\n        if room == 7:\n            print(f\"FOUND: Room 7 in {name} -&gt; handler 0x{handler:08X}\")\n",
